$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Payment

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Pay with nothing else on the page.
useFor: Paying for a cart or a booking.
notFor: Showing an invoice (use the cost breakdown sheet) or confirming a free request.

allowed: Toolbar · Secondary Pages / No Actions; Toolbar · Timer only when inventory is truly held (OR-08).
forbidden: A timer when nothing is held.
Any action that leaves the payment by accident.

allowed: The payment widget; PaymentDetails; official Apple Pay and wallet artwork.
forbidden: Offers, cross-sell or any band-6 content.
Pre-ticked consent or a saved card without consent.

allowed: The pay action lives in the widget.

rules: A hold timer appears only when inventory is held: lenient, with the reason stated, no ticking clock (OR-08, M4).
Failure opens StatusSheet · template payment-failed (General Bottom Sheet › Payment Failed), with a route to support; a hold that runs out opens template payment-expired (Payment session expired).
The amount equals the total shown at the step before. Nothing is added here (M4).
Digits 0 to 9; no blessing on receipts or errors (M6).
Ask for nothing the person already gave in this journey (M10).

allocation.App level: L3 · the transaction. Zero competing elements.
allocation.Interrupts: Payment failed is T1 commitment state: it passes every suppression window.
allocation.Support: Support is P5: one tap away on failure, never hidden by the payment flow.

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.

example.inTheFlowToday: The page uses Toolbar · Timer; confirm that stock is really held. The widget is a private component (_Payment widget Master).
